body.statement: For a polynomial covariance parametrization \(\phi_G\) over a field of characteristic zero, if the generic rank of its Jacobian is strictly smaller than \(|\theta_G|\), then the generic fiber of \(\phi_G\) has positive dimension; in particular, \(\phi_G\) is not generically finite-to-one.

source.locator: Section 3 discussion of the Jacobian-rank nonidentifiability argument and Section 7.1 generic-fiber computations

attestation.note: The published DOI and exact source sections are supplied; the lemma states the characteristic-zero Jacobian criterion used by the source's generic-fiber computation.
